book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Yesu la eivek Yerusalem nambei king
Ka xel la tyip paviy Yerusalem me la Betpage lek lukendu Oliv nei, Yesu wong betiyeing yuw la,

me neil wou luw, “Muw ghe na beyeeng tiwei muw mamim di yeila nei, lutika eno tyek muw ghe gwei dongi ti xel tup anghei inyon, is neu lingheing toukale lip ta. Muw wa tul luw xouing me na qou me ghe nam wou ay.
Wangwei xelti neil lulti wou muw, ond muw a neil wou bei Tambiy Ngandoung embei bong xuk en, dom tyek bong luw noum daing.”
Lul tine la teyei lek lul tiwei Anutu neil eivek poropet mya yo:

content.text: ‘Wei, xam xe king lam wou xam.
Moxo lam ambei tambiy wei lei maeing o me dei lek dongi ti.
Moxo dei lek dongi lingheing ti me lam.’” Sakarias 9:9

content: Betiyeing aluw la me wong e la teyei lek kawei Yesu neil wou luw o.
Luw qou dongi ta me neu lingheing, me vax luw xe teimb ding lek luw, de Yesu deilek lek.
Xel qendu ngandoung on vax xel xe teimb ding lek sakwaing, de xel valu qateiv xax memama me liw lek sakwaing.
Xel qendu ngandoung wei la mamunghexeing en e me xel wei di betiwou eno di taxe bei,

content.text: Mata ena wou tiwei lam eivek Tambiy Ngandoung lei yo! Qapiya Lalo 118:26
Hosana ena eivek tyoung gheyapu nei!”

content: Gyeik Yesu la eivek Yerusalem eno moux alis vex dalus wei beyeeng ngandoung on etek om xel teling, “Tambiy on eti?”
Xel qendu yon lewexe, “Tine inye Yesu, poropet wei lam anghei Nasaret eivek Galili yo.”
Yesu tiy xel wei wo vateivek veil xomek vambuing
Yesu la eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o me tiy xel wei di xouv lulul me wo vateivek anghei inyon o. Moxo qapyex lelek wei xel di pelipek malew me eti yeiw wei di wo vateivek lek menek beliy o.
Moxo neil wou xel, “Xel byex eivek xoulek eno nambei nye, ‘A xe xomek tyek xel taxe bei xomek wei zeimeing mema yo,’
ekom xam ghe pelipek e xok ambei ‘eeng wei xel panaxana yo.’
Xel wei mend tekeing me vaxend nol eno lam wou e eivek xomek vambuing, me moxo wong xel wo nimzalek.
Ekom xel lumuki leitata me putoung wei petieing lam yei lul nimza wei e wong o me yakyak wo vyend eivek xomek vambuing lalei, “Hosana ena wou Dawit Neu Moux,” om xel laleind wo nilul.
Xel teling e, “Beip wang ngo vati wei xel yakyak ti beimambei ne di neil ne?” Yesu neil elox. “E. Beip xam seng mi pyaw qayeeng,

content.text: “‘Eivek yakyak me yakyeis myend wang menyex wou bei
xel a mi sanghoxe wa leim’?” Qapiya Lalo 8:2

content: Om moxo la veil xel me la Yerusalem me la Betani, de moxo dei inyon boukeing tiyon.
Xax basunghek mupek
Satiboukeing lul, eno Yesu di la wou sakwaing bei nox Yerusalem, ekom maxepya e.

Moxo yei xax basunghek ti toukale wou sakwaing nenyawes, om la ingwei xax toukale ghei yo ekom se yei neing ti qe lis bandaing. Woyom moxo neil wou xax on, “Tyek wa seng nox buk neing no!” Se wo lululek en xax basunghek on mupek.
Gyeik xel betiyeing yei tine, moxoyeiw etek mouyo. Xel teling, “Xax basunghek tine mupek daing ambei nya?”

Yesu neil elox bei, “A neil wou xam zonghek, wangwei wa laleim se bo yuw en wa xe wongeingis nei, ond se nambei vati wei a wong wou xax basunghek ne venaxow, qe wa neil wou lukendu tine is ambei nyon, ‘La nex xow la eivek mamileeng,’ ond tyek bong ambei kawei wang neil o.
Wangwei wang bongis nei, tyek wa qou vatiyeiw wei wang teling en o eivek zeimeing mema.”
Xel teling Yesu en e lei wei ngandoung o

Yesu la eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing, ka moxo di teyoxe eno xel lumuki leitata me teivateiv wei xomaxoneing o lam wou e. Xel teling, “Wang di wong lulti beimambei ne nangya lei ngandoung wei eti yo? Me eti wong lei ngandoung tine wou wang?”

Yesu neil elox bei, “Tyek a bong telinyeing ti wou xam is ambei nyon. Wangwei xam a neil enoum wou a bombek nei, on tyek a neil wou xam en lei ngandoung wei eti ingwei a di wong lulti beimambei ne nangya ne.

Yoan xe lipekeing on lam anghei inya? Beip inyon lam anghei tyoung gheyapu nei, o inyon lam wou xomaxoneing?” Xel di luk en inye wouma me neil ambei nye, “Wangwei xey a neimbei, ‘Nanghei tyoung gheyapu nei,’ ond moxo tyek teling, ‘Woyom nambei nya xam seng wongis e?’
Ek wangwei xey a neimbei, ‘Inyon lam wou xomaxoneing,’ ond xey a ghaleeng en xomaxoneing, en xel dalus woulek bei Yoan ne poropet ti.”
Om xel neil e lox wou Yesu, “Xa loungen o.” Woyom moxo neil, “Ay is ambei nyon tyek a se neil wou xam en lei ngandoung vati wei andi wong lulti beimambei ne en o.
Qayeeng pakeing wei tambiy ti neu yuw o
“Xam ghe wou naleimim ambei nya? Inyon tambiy ti neu moux yayuw. Moxo la wou neu nge wei tax o me neil, ‘Neung, la me wo xuk eivek xuk wain gweimbeeng.’
“Moxo neil, ‘Tyek a se na.’ Dekalekom moxo lalei pekwi dom la.
“Woyom ma la wou nge wei moun me neil ambei kawei yo no. Moxo lewexe, ‘Mang, tyek a na yo.’ Ekom moxo se la.

“Eivek neu yuw on eno luw nge na wong ambei ingwei ma neil o?” Xel lewexe, “Nge wei tax o.” Yesu neil wou xel, “A neil wou xam zonghek, xel wei mi qou takis me vex wei kwapesiv o tyek na eivek tete lalei wei Anutu yo natax en xam.

En Yoan lam wou xam bei talex sakwaing wei bombek ayang o wou xam, ekom xam seng wongis e, qe xel wei mi qou takis me xel vex wei kwapesiv o eno wongis. Me xam ghe wei inye, ekom xam seng pekwi xow me ghe wongis e.
Qayeeng pakeing wei yeingteyei xuk wain o

“Xam a ni nenyamim wou qayeeng pakeing nge no, inyon tembuing ma ti ev e xe xuk wain. Moxo qo tete zeyi e vivekwou, me ev leiveeng wei qeing wain eivek o me ev xomek vaxading wei yeingteyei yo ti. Woyom moxo wong e xe xuk wain wou xel xukana valu dom la sakwaing anding.
Bouk wei uleing wain neing o lam paviy, om moxo wong e xe xukxe la wou xel wei yeiteyei xuk wain bei na dul e xe neing valu.
“Xel wei mi yeiteyei xuk wain eno zeimaxoun e xe xukxeyeiw, xel sesa ti, de leis nge mey, dom nex tiwei yal o en qakous.
Woyom moxo wong xukxe valu lox me la wou xel no, xel la ngenong ka ghanaw nge tax veil, me xel wei mi yeiteyei xuk wain eno wong ambei kawei xel wong nge tax o wou xel.
Ti yusayang eno moxo wong e maxow neu moux la wou xel. Moxo neil, ‘Tyek xel a ni nenyend wou a neung moux xe qayeeng.’
“Ekom xel wei mi yeiteyei xuk wain eno yei e neu moux om xel neil wouma, ‘Tine inye xukma neu moux wei tyek na qou lulul dalus o. Xam lam, en xey a nyeis e mey de na qou e xe lulul dalus.’
Om xel zeimaxoun e me nex e la myayaing veil xuk wain de leis e mey.
“Nambei nyon om gyeik xuk wain ma nam, ond tyek moxo bong vati wou xel wei mi yeiteyei xuk wain on?”

Xel neil elox bei, “Moxo tyek bo nol wou xel on bo nilul ayang me nyeis xel amey, de tyek moxo bong xuk wain on nox wou xel ba, eti yeiw wei teyei bei tyek bong xuk neing valu wou e gyeik bouk wei uleing neing o.”
Yesu neil wou xel, “Xam seng mi pyaw vati wei yeip eivek qapiya vambuing yo:

content.text: eno wong ambei qakous ti myaxeeng me mi byexaxoun xomek o.
Inye Tambiy Ngandoung venaxow wong tine belup,
me wo nimza eivek xa mami’? Qapiya Lalo 118:22-23

content: “Nambei nyon a neil wou xam bei Anutu tyek na qou e xe tete lalei veil xam me bong wou xomaxoneing qendu ti wei tyek bong neing atyip o.
De eti detei lek qakous nei tyek dembu me bo myapapu, ekom qakous embei detei lek tambiy ti eno tyek bo myasa bandaing.”
Gyeik xel lumuki leitata me Parisi ngo Yesu xe qayeeng pakeing tine, xel woulek bei Yesu di neil inye lek xel.
Om xel yimexe sakwaing wei xel embei zeimaxoun e yo, ekom xel di yaleeng en xel qendu ngandoung on en nambei xomaxoneing ngenong yei bei e yon poropet.
